StudyDesk - SQLite production dependency notices
================================================

This file covers the restored SQLite packages listed below. Package identities,
license identifiers and package copyright statements were read from the exact
versioned NuGet .nuspec files. Upstream license and NOTICE text is reproduced
without modification. Other StudyDesk dependencies have separate notices.

Native SQLite engine
--------------------
The SQLite engine underlying e_sqlite3.dll is dedicated to the public domain
by its authors. This is distinct from the Apache-2.0 licensing of the
SQLitePCLRaw packaging, build and interoperation components above.

Primary-source copyright and public-domain statement:
https://sqlite.org/copyright.html

These notices document the components above; they do not change their upstream
terms or assert legal compliance for the entire application or distribution.
